system.description: This power allows you to cause huge spikes to shoot out of walls, ceilings, and floors. The spikes are made of the same material as the surface from which they form, and can be especially dangerous to vampires in a wooden house or room. This attack is considered a ranged attack, requiring a challenge of your Mental Traits versus the target's Physical Traits. If successful, the target suffers two levels of nonaggravated damage. Wooden spikes that damage Kindred are accompanied by a Simple Test to see if the target has been staked (only one Simple Test is needed, due to the size of the spikes). Potence cannot be used in the challenge, as this is not a physical test of brute strength on the target's part.
